findings.observed: The problem of unknown school agreements is directly addressed by the outcome of a shared proposal of justified agreements.
findings.expected: Clear linkage between problem, purpose, and result.

findings.observed: The question '¿Cómo podemos explicar y poner en práctica nuestros acuerdos para convivir mejor?' is accessible to both 1st and 3rd grades.
findings.expected: Question must be accessible to all involved grades.

findings.observed: The project includes movement between two viable spaces (classroom and covered patio) as required by the ITINERANT profile.
findings.expected: Outcome must meet functional semantics, including movement between spaces.

findings.observed: 1st grade explains situations (F3-DHC-1-010) and 3rd grade investigates practices (F4-DHC-3-001) to build the shared proposal.
findings.expected: Full PDA development without thematic reduction.

findings.observed: Evidence includes oral explanations, registered consultations, and records of application in two spaces.
findings.expected: Evidence must correspond to the cognitive performance of the PDA.

findings.observed: Grades contribute interdependent pieces (drawings/explanations and consultation records) to a single shared proposal.
Each stage (frame, investigate, apply) produces a specific artifact (questions, explanations, completion record).
findings.expected: Progression must produce the result with operation, artifact, and evidence at each step.

findings.observed: Operations (investigation, application, analysis) are authentic; reflection is integrated into the analysis of the application.
findings.expected: Authentic methodology; reflection is not a substitute for intervention.

findings.observed: Supports (teacher modeling, peer support) are explicitly defined for the low autonomy profile.
findings.expected: Complexity and supports must be appropriate to grades and profiles.

findings.observed: Three sessions of 90 minutes are sufficient for the defined scope of two agreements.
findings.expected: Feasibility based on complexity and stages.

findings.observed: 1st and 3rd grades work on their respective PDAs without inheriting requirements from each other.
findings.expected: No inheritance of contents or requirements between grades.

findings.observed: LTG is not selected; justified by the context of using internal school experiences.
findings.expected: LTG must be pertinent or justified if absent.
